5e87819159.title: Malayalam cinema bids farewell to Pulimurugan cinematographer Shaji Kumar, who passed away at 57
5e87819159.headline: Malayalam cinema bids farewell to Pulimurugan cinematographer Shaji Kumar, who passed away at 57
5e87819159.caption:
Renowned cinematographer Shaji Kumar passed away in the early hours of November 10 at a private hospital in Kochi. He was 57. He was taken ill on November 7 while shooting a Dileep film in Alappuzha and was moved to Kochi, where he died of cardiac failure.

Shaji Kumar began his career as an independent cinematographer with Uthaman in 2001 and went on to shoot some of Malayalam cinema's biggest films, including Pulimurugan, Naran, Odiyan, Pokkiri Raja, Ramaleela, Pathonpatham Noottandu and Thudarum. In Tamil, he worked on Ponnar Shankar, Mambattiyan and Saahasam. His last works include Mohanlal's Athimanoharam, directed by Tharun Moorthy.

Rest in peace, Shaji Kumar. Thank you for the visuals that made us fall in love with cinema.

#shajikumar #pulimurugan #malayalamcinema #mollywood

70a6b1f0aa.title: Court orders case over use of mobile number in blockbuster Malayalam movie
70a6b1f0aa.headline: Court orders case over mobile number used in Officer on Duty
70a6b1f0aa.caption:
Kunchacko Boban starrer Officer on Duty faces legal trouble over a mobile number dispute in Mollywood cinema. The Ernakulam Chief Judicial Magistrate Court has directed the Ernakulam Central police to register a case on a private complaint alleging unauthorized use of a complainant's mobile number in the blockbuster Malayalam movie. The film was directed by debutant Jithu Ashraf and released in theatres in February 2025 before starting its streaming run on Netflix in multiple languages. Producer Martin Prakkat and the streaming platform may be arraigned as accused in the case concerning privacy and identity concerns. Reportedly, the mobile number has been in use since 2014 and remains linked to key documents including Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and bank accounts. The complainant allegedly began receiving unsolicited calls, including from abroad, after the number was displayed in the movie as a female character's contact number. This legal action highlights growing privacy concerns regarding personal information in the film industry.
